statement: Print the sum of each requested half-open range.
solutions:
import sys
data=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
it=iter(data)
n=next(it); q=next(it)
values=[next(it) for _ in range(n)]
prefix=[0]
for value in values:
    prefix.append(prefix[-1]+value)
out=[]
for _ in range(q):
    left=next(it); right=next(it)
    out.append(str(prefix[right]-prefix[left]))
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out))
import sys
data=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
it=iter(data)
n=next(it); q=next(it)
values=[next(it) for _ in range(n)]
stride=3
points=[0]
running=0
for index,value in enumerate(values,1):
    running+=value
    if index%stride==0:
        points.append(running)
def total_at(position):
    block=position//stride
    total=points[block]
    for index in range(block*stride,position):
        total+=values[index]
    return total
out=[]
for _ in range(q):
    left=next(it); right=next(it)
    out.append(str(total_at(right)-total_at(left)))
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out))

import sys
numbers=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n,q=numbers[:2]
values=numbers[2:2+n]
prefix=[0,*itertools.accumulate(values)]
queries=numbers[2+n:]
answers=(str(prefix[queries[i+1]]-prefix[queries[i]]) for i in range(0,2*q,2))
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(answers))
import sys
numbers=list(map(int,sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n,q=numbers[0],numbers[1]
values=numbers[2:n+2]
pos=n+2
answers=[]
for query in range(q):
    left,right=numbers[pos],numbers[pos+1]
    pos+=2
    total=0
    index=left
    while index<right:
        total+=values[index]
        index+=1
    answers.append(str(total))
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(answers))
